methodValues: Diffusion (without MMD loss, rerun1) and Gaussian case studies. Results are separated by case study, diagnostic, assumed model, summary dimension and error metric.

Diffusion uses matching-network NPE-MCMC references after filtering importance ESS / logML draws >= 0.20. Gaussian uses well-specified matching-network NPE-analytical references. All thresholds are network/configuration specific and remain in raw units.
e=MMD>=0; L=0; U=q95(MMDref). Diffusion reference values use the ESS filter. Error is outside the typical range when e>U.
e=estimated logML - reference logML. Diffusion reports log10 units and uses ESS-filtered L=q5(eref), U=q95(eref); Gaussian keeps natural-log units and uses L=q5(eref), U=q95(eref).
e=estimated PMP - reference PMP. Diffusion uses ESS-filtered L=q5(eref), U=q95(eref); Gaussian uses L=q5(eref), U=q95(eref). No absolute value or normalization is used.
ρᵢ is the raw diagnostic score; diagnostic-positive classification uses ρᵢ>1.

ROC-AUC(zᵢ, ρᵢ), where zᵢ=1[eᵢ<Lᵢ or eᵢ>Uᵢ], calculated separately for each source group × diagnostic × assumed model × summary dimension × error metric. AUC requires the underlying per-sample labels and scores.
N/A when all zᵢ values in a group are identical, because an ROC curve requires both classes.
Not used anywhere in the classification, confusion counts, FNR, FPR, F1 or AUC in this workbook.
Diffusion: benchmark/examples/diffusion/results/NPE_results and posterior_diagnostics (noMMD_rerun1-tagged caches). Gaussian: benchmark/examples/gaussian/results/ood_* diagnostic frames.
